bullets: [ULTIMATE PORTABILITY GEAR] Made of 100% premium grade Carbon Fiber, each walking stick weighs only 8.2 oz, keeping your hiking gear ultra lightweight. Lighter & more versatile than aluminum, you move quicker and exert less energy for efficient and longer distance climb or hike.

[SUPREME SECURE STABILITY] Our flip lock levers are easy to adjust & lock in place securely. More secured locking than twist lock or hiking poles that slide out. We use metal locks vs. plastic for ultimate strength and security

[ERGONOMIC COMFY-GRIP] Moisture-wicking ergonomic cork grips that conform to your grip shape for the ultimate fit. A nonslip groove EVA Foam Grip extension under the cork grip for quick use on steep climbs. Breathable hand straps for secure hold and reduce hand fatigue for all-day comfort

[MADE FOR EVERYBODY] Our trekking poles are retractable from 90cm to 135cm, for both short & tall Women, Men, & Kids! Built for backpacking, camping or simple Nordic walks, our hiking sticks is the perfect camping essentials or outdoor gifts

[LIFETIME WARRANTY FROM A TRUSTED BRAND] Our trekking Poles come with snow plates, mud plates, nordic walking buffer tips, rubber tips and the sporty bag for both hiking poles. ABOVE ALL, our lifetime product guarantee and prompt aftersales support
capture.description: Embrace the great outdoors with KINGGEAR's 100% Carbon Fiber Trekking Poles. Lightweight and durable, these hiking poles are designed to enhance your hiking, trekking, and mountaineering experiences. They offer an adjustable height mechanism, perfect for every adventurer. The anti-shock design coupled with comfortable handles provides a sturdy, non-slip grip for stability on all terrains. The moisture-wicking grip combined with weather-resistant properties makes them suitable for use in any climatic conditions. The trekking poles also fold down compactly, making them easy to carry and store. Invest in these high-performance trekking poles to upgrade your outdoor gear and enjoy a boosted hiking experience. With KINGGEAR, embrace the thrill of mountaineering and the serenity of nature walks. Equip yourself with KINGGEAR - where quality meets adventure.
